name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods for working in git worktrees and watching usage: a terminal and a merge status pane for the worktrees, and a usage band above the prompt

plugins.name: worktree-terminal
plugins.description: /terminal: show or open a Terminal-panel tab in the conversation's git worktree (Claude desktop app)

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: usage windows, prompt-cache warmth and age, context to re-cache, next message cost per model

plugins.name: worktree-merge-status
plugins.description: /merge-status: a pane with what merged into local main and which git worktrees conflict with it, with a link to each worktree's session
